definitions.meaning: a fielder stationed in the slips cordon beside the wicketkeeper, the second man along
a further slip, a second error

explanation.surface: A fielder blunders yet again.
explanation.walkthrough: SECOND SLIP is a cricket fielding position next to the wicketkeeper; read literally it is a repeat error. 'made' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense names a fielding position in cricket; the other reads the words literally as a further error.

parts.note: putting on make-up is being made up; in a down clue, written upwards, that word turns into a Dutch cheese

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether Dutch make-up was put on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Applied cosmetics' is MADE UP; in a down entry 'up' tells you to write MADE upwards, giving the cheese named after a Dutch town.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is a round cheese named after a town in Holland.

clue.text: Give firm backing to a system of worship that's mystical

indicators.note: backing means the abbreviation for firm is turned round, read from the end

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a cult is a system of religious worship

explanation.surface: Support a religion that has mystical leanings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses CO to OC; 'Give' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe secret, hidden knowledge beyond ordinary understanding.

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, for Diana

indicators.note: something torn into tears is ripped apart, so the letters of the word before are rearranged

explanation.surface: A distressed girl starts crying.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'burst into tears' as weeping; in fact 'into tears' means ripped apart, signalling an anagram of the word before it.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset someone is to unsettle or trouble them; both are verbs.

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of the word role take a fresh order

explanation.surface: An actor takes on study as a fresh part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes an anagram of ROLE; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lore is traditional knowledge, the body of things learned and passed on.

parts.note: an address here is a speech, one meant to cheer listeners up, not a street location

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether there was applause at a house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'address' looks like a postal location, but it is a speech given to encourage a team or group.
explanation.definitionFit: A short motivating speech, the kind given by a coach, aims to raise spirits.

definitions.meaning: stubborn and wilful
read literally, having a powerful head

explanation.surface: Someone is stubborn yet clever.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is whimsical: strong in the head, i.e. clever, hence the question mark. 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Stubborn and wilful is the usual sense; the playful one splits the word into a strong head.

clue.text: They fly some flag in trouble

indicators.note: trouble means the letters of the words before are stirred up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A flag gets tangled up while flying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' shuffles all ten letters of SOME FLAG IN; 'in' is fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-legged pink wading birds, which take to the air in flocks.

definitions.meaning: a small unit of spies or activists working together
a small room where a prisoner is locked up

explanation.surface: A spy ring is behind bars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a covert unit of operatives and a lock-up room for a convict share this word.

clue.text: It secures an armed timing device

definitions.text: It secures an armed timing device

parts.words: It secures an armed timing device
parts.note: the timing device is worn on the arm, not loaded with weapons; this band holds it there

explanation.surface: Something makes a bomb's timer safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'armed timing device' suggests a bomb, but it is just a timepiece on someone's wrist.
explanation.definitionFit: A band fastening a timepiece around the wrist.

parts.note: not a bike four feet long, but one ridden by two people, so four feet on the pedals

explanation.surface: A bicycle measuring four feet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'four-foot' looks like a size, but it counts the riders' feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A bicycle built for two riders, one behind the other.

definitions.meaning: to teach, as a university speaker does
to scold someone at length

explanation.surface: Teach or tell someone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' is a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to teach by giving a talk and to scold someone.

parts.note: a figure on horseback that Peeping Tom spied on in the Coventry legend

explanation.surface: A man examines the shape of a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: In the legend, a noblewoman rode naked through Coventry; Peeping Tom, the one man who looked, was struck blind. 'form' is her body, not a horse's shape.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary eleventh-century noblewoman who rode naked on horseback through Coventry.

definitions.meaning: something told privately, in trust
trust or faith in someone or something

explanation.surface: A private conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: A private disclosure is told in this, and it is also trust or assurance.

indicators.note: to be suggests the word before is to become something else, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone consents keenly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be' loosely signals that AGREE is made into something new; a weak indicator, but the letters fit exactly.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and enthusiastic are synonyms for wanting something very much.

parts.note: a flat is an apartment
number ten, spelt out

explanation.surface: Knock down the Prime Minister's residence at No 10.
explanation.walkthrough: No 10 Downing Street is the British Prime Minister's home, but here it is just the number written as a word.
explanation.definitionFit: To level a building is to knock it to the ground.

definitions.meaning: a navy's vessels taken together
swift, quick-moving

explanation.surface: Vessels were secured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made fast' suggests mooring, but 'made' is a link and 'fast' means swift.
explanation.definitionFit: A navy's vessels together, and also an adjective for swift movement.

clue.text: Check a section of the billiard table

definitions.meaning: to hesitate or stop short, or to thwart

definitions.text: a section of the billiard table
definitions.meaning: the area behind the line at one end of the table, from which play starts

explanation.surface: Inspect part of a snooker table.
explanation.walkthrough: The billiards sense is the area behind the baulk line where play begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To balk is to stop short or thwart; it also names an area at the end of a billiard table.

parts.note: not soundly defeated, but a small depression knocked into a surface

explanation.surface: Thoroughly defeated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beaten hollow' is an idiom for heavily defeated; here it is a hollow made by beating.
explanation.definitionFit: A small depression knocked into a surface, as in a car body.

indicators.note: double means the following word's synonym is written twice in a row

parts.note: do means act or perform

explanation.surface: A comedy duo who have vanished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Double act' suggests a comedy pair, but 'Double' repeats DO. 'no longer seen' fits an extinct bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The extinct flightless bird of Mauritius, which nobody will ever see again.

parts.note: René is a French man's name

explanation.surface: A Frenchman is swapped for a Welshman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To renew is to restore or put something fresh in place of the old.

definitions.meaning: turns down, refuses
flawed goods sent back or sold off cheaply

explanation.surface: A shop refuses damaged goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb for turning something down, and a noun for flawed goods discarded or sold off.

clue.text: Lew rang, but became involved in argument

indicators.note: something involved is tangled, so the letters of the words before are mixed up

explanation.surface: Lew telephoned but got drawn into a row.
explanation.walkthrough: 'became involved' scrambles LEW RANG; 'but' and 'in' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, noisy dispute is a quarrel or row.

indicators.note: after places the word for youngsters behind the letter from midnight

parts.note: the middle letter of night is G
a litter is a group of young animals born together

explanation.surface: Children dazzle in the small hours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midnight' is a crossword convention for the middle of 'night', the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: To glitter is to sparkle with bright flashes of light.

clue.text: Depressing features for weathermen, but pigs like them!

definitions.meaning: areas of low pressure on a weather chart
long feeding containers for livestock

explanation.surface: Forecasters dislike low points, but pigs love them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depressing' is a pun on meteorological depressions, low-pressure areas. 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Elongated regions of low pressure on a weather map, and long feeding boxes for farm animals.

clue.text: He takes great interest in your need for cash

definitions.text: He takes great interest in your need for cash

parts.words: He takes great interest in your need for cash
parts.note: great interest here is a high rate charged on a loan, not curiosity

explanation.surface: A kindly man cares about your money troubles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes great interest' sounds sympathetic, but it means charging exorbitant interest.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging excessive rates of interest.

parts.note: profoundly here means making it deeper, by scooping out mud from the bottom

explanation.surface: Someone asks about transforming a port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Profoundly' means greatly, but literally it is 'deeply': you deepen a harbour by clearing silt.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoop silt from the bed of a waterway, deepening it.

parts.note: a mount here is a mountain that erupts, not a hot-tempered horse

explanation.surface: A spirited horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mount' suggests a horse, but it is a mountain: a volcano in Sicily.
explanation.definitionFit: The active volcano on Sicily, Europe's highest.

clue.text: Like to take one over a continent

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the earlier pieces above the final A

parts.note: as means like
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone is fond of taking one person across a landmass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take' is a link; 'over' places AS and I above A.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest of the world's landmasses, stretching from Turkey to Japan.

clue.text: I agree cost is incorporated in order

indicators.note: incorporated means worked into a new body, so the letters of the words before are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone accepts the cost is built into a plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is incorporated' rearranges I AGREE COST; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sort into classes is to arrange or put in order.

clue.text: Deputy in the grip of depravity

definitions.meaning: a second-in-command
wickedness or immoral behaviour

explanation.surface: A second-in-command is held by wickedness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the grip of' links the senses but also hints at a third: a vice is a gripping tool on a workbench.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in in rank, as with vice-chairman, and also immoral conduct.

parts.note: loaf here is a baked item that has sat around too long, not idling

explanation.surface: Someone asks if they may laze about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loaf around' suggests idling, but it is a loaf that has been around for some time.
explanation.definitionFit: Old baked goods gone hard after sitting out for days.
